project_type: React + Vite + TypeScript SPA (PWA) with Three.js
build_system: Vite (via npm). Must source NVM first: source /root/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 22
test_framework: No unit test framework found; Playwright for e2e
verification_instructions: Run tsc --noEmit. Only pre-existing error is react-router-dom in unused file (src/infrastructure/router/useNavigateTab.ts). All other TS errors are regressions.
environment_constraints: Must use nvm to activate Node 22 before any npm/node commands.
key_patterns: Design system: OmicronChrome (OmicronCard, OmicronHeader, Chip, Stat, ProgressBar) in src/shared/components/OmicronChrome.tsx. Colors from getUserColor() instead of C.cyan. GeodesicOrb (SVG) in src/shared/components/GeodesicOrb.tsx is the replacement for ParticleOrb (Three.js). SuggestionChips was removed from UI but import remains. ScanlineOverlay from CyberComponents still used in several tabs.
directory_structure: src/features/{omicron,gemelo,academia,auth,chat,wallet,gobernanza,market,empleos}/components/. Shared utilities in src/shared/. Store in src/store/. Theme in src/theme.ts
